items.title: [Bondy] James Wiseman has impressed in camp and he's the current favorite to take the 14th spot of Knicks' roster (New York can't add a 15th player because it would push them over the second apron). Tony Bradley, Drew Eubanks, Bruce Brown, Ochai Agbaji are the other players vying for the 14th spot.
items.author: PianoJealous307
items.body_excerpt: There is now a key player favored to secure the New York Knicks' final roster spot ahead of the 2026-27 NBA season. Per Stefan Bondy of the New York Post, James Wiseman has emerged as a candidate who could fill the reigning NBA champs' 14th roster spot. Wiseman's chances lean on…

items.title: Bradley's deal is guaranteed in Year 1.
items.author: Blake Murphy
items.body_excerpt:
Bradley's deal is guaranteed in Year 1.

Non-guaranteed in Years 2 and 3, with an early guarantee trigger date.

Team option in Year 4.

Deal uses part of the mid-level, NOT 2nd-round pick exception.

quote.author: Blake Murphy
quote.text:
The Raptors have signed Jaden Bradley to a multi-year deal.

This opens up a 2-way spot for a bunch of the Exhibit 10s to compete for.

Bradley was only player Raptors could add as a 14th without waiting a few weeks into the season, as your 2nd-rounder has a smaller apron hit.
